repairs_verified: The staging build now authenticates before mounting the real TanStack product router instead of replacing it with the hosted status shell.

Hosted Queue, Library, Settings, worker enrollment, cancellation, short-lived private-R2 downloads, and explicit permanent output deletion are tenant-scoped and fail closed without hosted dependencies.
Browser writes for CPU submission, cancellation, and output deletion require the configured same origin.
Migration 0033 serializes personal-CPU project admission and enforces one active project per account and two globally while allowing same-project stages and reconciliation attempts.
Submission preparation now compensates before dispatch on R2 or Workflow failure, and deadline expiry preserves the submitted-at database invariant.
The Neon runtime grant includes only the workspace read needed by hosted session scope; tenant reads set the account principal transaction-locally.
R2 download ports permit the intended one-hour maximum while upload ports retain the fifteen-minute maximum and bind a safe content-disposition filename.
The release workflow signs, notarizes, staples, validates, and Gatekeeper-assesses the final macOS disk image, then removes transient signing material.
A local installed-Chrome hosted-router test proves auth gating, real product-shell mounting, Queue, Library, Settings, and manual Delete wiring against mocked hosted APIs. It is not deployment proof.

P1.detail: The real product router is mounted after hosted authentication, but the hosted adapter composes only status, tenant, personal-worker, Queue, Library, CPU-attempt, and manual-delete routes. Create Project, presets, project/review, usage/cost, and the complete generation-to-playback APIs still return HOSTED_ROUTE_NOT_COMPOSED. V2-06 therefore has no complete hosted product journey.

The fail-closed Windows signing and final-DMG signing/notarization contract is present, but no Windows Authenticode release or macOS Developer-ID/notarized release was built, installed, or published. The user has no Apple Developer Program membership, so compliant macOS publication is currently externally blocked.

No immutable evidence proves a deployed Cloudflare Worker/Workflow, real Better Auth admission, Neon non-superuser RLS, tenant-private R2, two-account/device isolation, real personal-worker claim/render/result, durable offline/restart/cancel recovery, backup/restore, rollback, or the full journey in hosted Chrome. Local fixtures cannot prove deployment.

P2.detail: No real Windows 10/11 x64 or macOS evidence covers signed install, one-click pairing, autostart/reboot, sleep, offline/reconnect, cancellation, stale leases/results, streaming R2, update/remove, ASR/render parity, or the canonical 30-minute workload.

Scale-to-zero Cloud Run ASR/render parity is no longer an acceptance requirement after DEC_PERSONAL_WORKER_001. Historical Cloud Run material is rollback-only; the active architecture requires zero hosted CPU jobs and account-owned Windows/macOS workers.
This audit was performed in the same task as the repairs and cannot satisfy the independent acceptance gate.
